hypothesis: The unchanged integrated detector can ingest the organizer synthetic PointCloud2 bag and report object presence separately from corridor intersection.
criterion: Process the first 10 consecutive scans without invalid serialization or native crash; inspect geometry, cloud layout and preserved outputs before full replay. This is an actual detector run, not an automated test.
limitations: Organizer descriptions give order and approximate 100 m spacing, not timestamped boxes or full 3D dimensions.
Only XYZI fields are present; no ring or per-point acquisition time.
Record time and acquisition time use different epochs; their difference is not sensor latency.
